nodes.title: “Claude can’t see the running page I need it to fix”
nodes.feature_idea: Add a compact, one-click agent handoff that bundles the captured browser state and tells the agent how to use the evidence without claiming live browser access.

nodes.title: “I keep copying browser errors into the agent by hand”
nodes.feature_idea: Provide a copy-for-agent action that puts a concise evidence summary and prompt on the clipboard alongside the existing ZIP export.

nodes.title: “The agent invents API behavior because my browser session is elsewhere”
nodes.feature_idea: Make captured request and response evidence easy to locate and understand in the agent report, without adding new cURL or HAR export behavior.

nodes.title: “My cloud agent can’t run the browser needed to verify frontend work”
nodes.feature_idea: Emphasize the portable recorded-session report as context a cloud agent can inspect after the browser session, while stating that it does not provide a runnable browser.

nodes.title: “The browser tool is configured, but the agent still can’t use it”
nodes.feature_idea: Offer the existing offline evidence export as an explicit fallback when live browser-agent integration is unavailable.

nodes.title: “The agent’s browser tools return data it can’t use”
nodes.feature_idea: Improve report navigation from a captured request summary to its existing response/body assets, without creating a second HAR or cURL flow.

nodes.title: “A code change or passing test doesn’t show me the UI fix worked”
nodes.feature_idea: Add a report handoff prompt that presents the recorded failure and asks the coding agent to reproduce it and attach post-fix browser evidence.

nodes.title: “The agent says it added screenshots, but the PR evidence is missing or broken”
nodes.feature_idea: Make the report’s screenshot manifest and linked image artifacts easy to verify before attaching them to an issue or PR.

nodes.title: “Some coding-agent workflows still need a visual artifact they can actually inspect”
nodes.feature_idea: Clarify in the exported agent prompt that screenshot files are included and identify which asset paths to inspect.

nodes.title: “Copying browser requests can leak credentials into an agent prompt”
nodes.feature_idea: Do not add a new general redaction feature in this run; retain user-controlled review and avoid exposing report contents through a local MCP service.

nodes.title: “A full browser network dump wastes agent context on noise”
nodes.feature_idea: Prefer an agent-facing compact report summary with drill-down references instead of another network trimming mechanism.

nodes.title: “A browser crawler can click around but still miss the bug that matters”
nodes.feature_idea: Put the recorded narration, annotations and expected-versus-observed notes prominently in the agent handoff prompt.

nodes.title: “A local agent bridge can expose more browser or machine data than intended”
nodes.feature_idea: Do not introduce a local MCP bridge as the handoff path; keep report sharing explicit and offline by default.

top_pick.feature: Add a compact, one-click agent handoff that bundles the captured browser state and tells the agent how to use the evidence without claiming live browser access.
